title: OTLP Specification 1.11.0
versionOrDate: OTLP Specification 1.11.0; reviewed 2026-08-02; trace, metric and log protocol status Stable, profiles Development
relevance: Normative protocol contract for encoding, transporting and acknowledging telemetry between sources, Collectors and backends. It defines full success, partial success, failures and retry behavior, including that populated partial-success responses are not retried. Its stable status covers trace, metric and log transport in version 1.11.0, while profiles remain development-stage; protocol acceptance is not proof of durable backend storage, query visibility or complete end-to-end delivery.
